name: Smith Machine Incline Triceps Extension
steps: Set the bench to a moderate incline and align the rails so the bar clears the top of your head.
Lie back, plant your feet and take a shoulder-width overhand grip before releasing the hooks.
Keep your upper arms angled slightly back and stationary with your elbows pointed forward.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar just beyond your hairline while keeping your upper arms steady.
Contract your triceps firmly to extend your elbows and press the bar straight back up to lockout.
tips: Align the bench carefully with an unloaded bar so the fixed path clears your face safely.
Keep your elbows tucked relatively close rather than flaring wide to the sides.
